description: Phase 2: Foundation Model Integration — TimesFM/Chronos adapter, hybrid inference fallback, and diffusion-based market simulation

userStories.title: TimesFM foundation model adapter
userStories.description: As the scanner, I need a drop-in foundation model that replaces the custom CNN-Transformer with a pre-trained time-series model (TimesFM) fine-tuned via LoRA.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/sota_core/timesfm_adapter.py exists with TimesFMAdapter class
Accepts raw OHLCV input (same contract as RawSequenceModel)

userStories.title: Hybrid inference with fallback safety
userStories.description: As the scanner, I need a hybrid inference layer that ensembles foundation model + custom model + XGBoost, with OOD detection fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/sota_core/hybrid_inference.py exists with HybridInference class
Ensemble: foundation model + custom CNN-Transformer + XGBoost
OOD detection: input reconstruction error > 2σ → fallback to custom model

userStories.title: Diffusion-based market simulation
userStories.description: As the backtest engine, I need a diffusion model that generates synthetic market paths for stress testing the factor portfolio.
acceptanceCriteria: Architecture: latent diffusion model trained on daily factor returns
Generate N synthetic paths given a seed and regime context
Validation: KS test + autocorrelation matching against real returns
Use cases: stress test, synthetic training data augmentation
